query: Please implement a logistics management and maintenance platform for maintaining customer business data. The platform should have functionalities such as enterprise management, personnel management, menu maintenance, business maintenance, business statistics, automatic error checking, business code maintenance, and log query. Users should be able to log in to the platform, browse and maintain customer business data, manually correct errors in script execution, and perform business statistics and log queries. Set overall background to orchid, then style components with purple.
